cn.description:
第一眼，是星空里的一位小小旅人。展开画面，才发现他正坐在连接两颗星球的细线上。

Duopaper 把这种先聚焦、再揭晓的惊喜，藏进精挑细选的数字艺术。闭合时看见一个耐人寻味的细节，展开后读懂更宽阔的场景。同一张图片，两种观看方式，让折叠屏与宽屏有了更有趣的表达。

选一幅，看看它藏了什么
安静的留白、俏皮的小动物、充满想象的太空与海洋，都可以成为屏幕上的小故事。每幅作品都有自己的构图和气质。先看局部，再看全景，找到那幅让你会心一笑的画，而不只是换一个颜色。

从你喜欢的画风开始
极简、插画、漫画、3D、图形与绘画，多种视觉语言带来不同心情。按风格浏览，或搜索感兴趣的作品名称；从干净的线条到柔和的绘画质感，为通勤、休息或想放松的时刻，选一张合眼缘的图。

先体验，再决定
在预览里开合画面，拖动滑杆看看故事怎样展开。可以显示时钟，调整预览焦点，比较闭合与展开时的视觉重心。把不同作品放到同一种观看方式下，挑选更从容。

喜欢，就留在身边
点一下心形收藏，随时回来继续看。所有作品都可离线浏览，收藏与偏好保存在本机。保存时导出完整图片，也可以通过系统分享给朋友；预览里的时钟与焦点不会写进保存的图片。

完整体验免费开放，没有广告、内购、订阅或登录要求。慢慢找、随心选，把屏幕留给自己喜欢的画面。

保存后，请在照片中手动设为壁纸。预览为构图参考，系统裁切与开合效果可能不同。

cn.description:
RPGViewer 是一款用来运行你自己项目的播放器 —— 你自己的 RPG Maker 与 Flash 游戏。它是从零开始重写的原生 iOS 应用。

游戏由你带来，RPGViewer 负责运行它。

一款 App，覆盖你手上真正在用的那些引擎：

• RPG Maker XP、VX 与 VX Ace —— 通过移植的 RGSS 原生引擎直接运行，不是模拟。原速运行，中间不隔浏览器。
• RPG Maker MV 与 MZ —— 完整支持，包括 OGG 音频，无需重新转码。
• Flash（SWF）—— 通过 Ruffle 播放，包括那些从未被转成 HTML5 的 Flash 游戏。
• HTML5 游戏 —— 任何自包含的网页，从库里打开即可。

为在手机上游玩而做
• 屏幕虚拟手柄，按键可自定义。把任意实体或屏幕按键绑定到游戏读取的按键上。
• 支持真实手柄。接上手柄即接管，屏幕手柄会自动让位。
• 统一的菜单。所有引擎都是同一个控件、同一个位置，只有行数变化 —— 而且只显示真正能用的功能。
• 原生引擎游戏支持快进。
• 支持横屏与竖屏，iPhone 与 iPad 皆可。

仅限 RPG Maker MV 与 MZ
• 菜单内置作弊面板 —— 不离开游戏即可调整数值、道具与队伍成员。

请注意
• RPGViewer 只是播放器，不含任何游戏，也无法下载游戏。请确认你运行的项目来自正当渠道。
• 它是通用运行环境，不修改 RPG Maker 或 Flash 项目的源代码，也不模拟它们。
• Flash 播放由 Ruffle 提供。依赖服务器端组件或需要联网服务的游戏无法运行。

为正在做 RPG Maker 游戏的人而做：在发布前先在手机上试一遍，同时继续玩你已有的那些游戏。

hk.description:
畫面中央，一位太空旅人坐在細細的線上。把視野打開，原來這條線連著兩顆星球。

Duopaper 為你的螢幕準備這樣的小小發現。同一張桌布，合起來時是一處細節，展開後是一個更完整的場景。原本熟悉的角落，因為多看見一點而變得有趣。讓寬螢幕的空間，不只裝下更多，也裝下更多想像。

找一張讓你停下來看的圖
有些畫乾淨安靜，有些帶著俏皮的角色，有些把宇宙與海洋變成一段奇遇。每幅作品經過挑選，保留鮮明構圖與自己的個性。從局部看到全貌，慢慢找出適合你心情的那一張。

選你喜歡的視覺語言
簡約、插圖、漫畫、立體、圖像設計與繪畫，各有不同的表情。可以依風格瀏覽，或搜尋作品名稱。喜歡柔和色調、鮮明對比，還是乾淨的留白？讓螢幕的樣子，跟著你的品味走。

先試著打開它
用開合按鈕與滑桿，看看同一幅圖在不同寬度下如何呈現。切換時鐘、調整預覽焦點，感受視線落在哪裡。兩種觀看狀態都看過，再決定想把哪一幅留在身邊。

把喜歡的好好收著
點一下愛心加入珍藏，下次直接回來找。作品與預覽都能離線開啟，偏好保留在裝置上。儲存時會保留完整圖片，也能使用系統分享；時鐘與焦點調整只出現在預覽，不會印進匯出的圖檔。

全部內容免費使用，沒有廣告、App 內購買或訂閱，也不必建立帳號。少一點打擾，多一點看圖的樂趣。

儲存後，請在照片中手動設為桌布。預覽僅供構圖參考，系統裁切與開合效果可能不同。

hk.releaseNotes: Digline 的內容越來越多囉！有傳言說，從你鄰居家再往左走，來了一位神秘的新人物。他還帶來了一大堆實驗，等你在鑽機上試一試。至少有幾個應該會成功……大概吧。
hk.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

hk.description:
擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

■ 隨選擇擴展的技能樹
從攻擊力、攻擊速度、特殊能力等方向中，選擇自己想要的成長路線。
優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

■ 不斷變強的武器
武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

遊戲特色
- 越戰越強的增量式成長
- 透過收集資源與反覆強化提升火力
- 隨選擇變化的技能樹
- 運用卡牌和遺物搭配流派
- 個性十足的異次元傭兵
- 閃電、冰凍、隕石、迴旋鏢等多種能力
- 可持續強化的武器
- 可愛的2D像素畫面
- 鋪滿畫面的史萊姆與爽快打擊感

※ 注意：查看成長數值時，時間可能會轉眼消失！

hk.description:
Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

== Game Intro ==

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

◆Lighthearted Additional Content◆
Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

◆iCloud Support◆
Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? 
Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures! - Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business
- Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies

hk.description:
黃金時刻每天都會出現，但大多數人都錯過了。Solar Arc 讓你不再錯過。

Solar Arc 是一款像望向窗外一樣的太陽與月亮追蹤 App。螢幕上的天空隨真實光線變化：光線溫暖時溫暖，天黑時深沉。

漸層線
用一條線畫出你的一整天。黎明的琥珀色、正午的藍色、日落的橘色、夜晚的深藍。黃金時刻閃耀，藍調時刻沉靜。只看顏色就知道現在是一天中的什麼時候。

弧線

hk.description:
有史以來最好的劈砍遊戲現在能夠放進您的口袋裡了！

最初於2006年在電腦上發布的《泰坦之旅》是一款動作角色扮演遊戲，設定為神話的背景。泰坦從監獄逃脫，不顧一切地要毀滅地球。上帝自個不能阻止他們-需要一個英雄來領導這場史詩般的爭鬥。勝利或失敗都將決定人類的命運和奧林匹亞的命運。

您就是英雄！創建您的角色，探索遠古的文明如希臘、埃及、巴比倫和中國，並與成群的傳奇生物戰鬥！掌握射箭、劍法或者魔法的藝術，併升級您的角色來解鎖令人驚嘆的力量！發現特別的項目來幫助您完成您的任務：傳說中的劍，毀滅性的雷電，施了魔法的弓，以及更多！

這個特別適用於移動設備的新版本提供了許多新的特點：

● 全新的點觸操作界面

● 巨大的、開放的世界供您探索

● 逐級增進的難度模式：與您的技能水平匹配的武器和敵人
● 數十種不可鎖定的成就等待您去發現
● 無廣告，沒有微交易。

混合了遠古神話和不停的動作的《泰坦之旅》是一款典型的劈砍遊戲，以快速、激烈的節奏提供活力十足的遊戲。征服驚心動魄的挑戰，戰勝入侵移動世界的最強大敵人！

可在應用內購買的DLC： 
● 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。
● 在諸神黃昏下載包的北歐未知土地上，你將勇敢面對凱爾特人、諾斯曼人和阿斯加迪神靈的領地！
● 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！
● 在永恆餘燼DLC 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

你將扮演復仇之星主角伍迪（Woody），在這檔虛構但名副其實的電視節目第1季和第2季中，一路惡作劇到底。把惡作劇從你那討厭鄰居的公寓帶到中國、印度和墨西哥，在那裡你要確保他的假期變成一場活生生的地獄。既然都動手了，當你可以把他的母親和同行旅客也拉下水時，為什麼還要侷限於鄰居一人呢？

This Is the Police 2是廣受好評的黑色劇“This Is the Police”的續集，你可以在其中酌情解釋法律！運行警長的部門，管理你的員警，調查，審問和監禁。在這個由故事推動的冒險、戰略和回合制戰術戰鬥混合遊戲中，做出艱難的決定 - 並儘量避免自己入獄！

這是模擬？管理遊戲？戰術挑戰？視覺小說？謎題？全部都是，還不止！

深入獨一無二的故事推動體驗。
歡迎來到夏普伍德，一個寒冷而嚴酷的邊境小鎮，充滿了暴力，沒有人是完全無辜的。這個城鎮是走私者、幫派和尖叫的民粹主義者的老巢。為了維護和平與秩序，年輕的警長莉莉·裡德（莎拉·漢密爾頓）不得不與逃犯傑克·博伊德（喬恩·聖約翰）合作，並祈禱她的危險計畫不會失控。

掌管警長的部門。
你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

mo.description:
畫面中央，一位太空旅人坐在細細的線上。把視野打開，原來這條線連著兩顆星球。

Duopaper 為你的螢幕準備這樣的小小發現。同一張桌布，合起來時是一處細節，展開後是一個更完整的場景。原本熟悉的角落，因為多看見一點而變得有趣。讓寬螢幕的空間，不只裝下更多，也裝下更多想像。

找一張讓你停下來看的圖
有些畫乾淨安靜，有些帶著俏皮的角色，有些把宇宙與海洋變成一段奇遇。每幅作品經過挑選，保留鮮明構圖與自己的個性。從局部看到全貌，慢慢找出適合你心情的那一張。

選你喜歡的視覺語言
簡約、插圖、漫畫、立體、圖像設計與繪畫，各有不同的表情。可以依風格瀏覽，或搜尋作品名稱。喜歡柔和色調、鮮明對比，還是乾淨的留白？讓螢幕的樣子，跟著你的品味走。

先試著打開它
用開合按鈕與滑桿，看看同一幅圖在不同寬度下如何呈現。切換時鐘、調整預覽焦點，感受視線落在哪裡。兩種觀看狀態都看過，再決定想把哪一幅留在身邊。

把喜歡的好好收著

mo.releaseNotes: Digline 的內容越來越多囉！有傳言說，從你鄰居家再往左走，來了一位神秘的新人物。他還帶來了一大堆實驗，等你在鑽機上試一試。至少有幾個應該會成功……大概吧。
mo.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

您想當導演、製片、主演……嗎？

通過電影精靈，您可以把各種媒體素材如視頻、照片、音樂、文字、錄音以及手指塗鴉等，按照您的創意，把它們編輯組合在一起，並給它們添加各種特效（場景切換特效、文字動畫、濾鏡特效、片頭、蒙版等），創作出屬於您自己的微電影。

主要功能：

-可裁剪、分割、合併、縮放各種媒體素材
-疊加多層視頻（畫中畫效果），視頻數量沒有限制
-添加各種蒙版（線性蒙版、矩形蒙版、圓形蒙版、文字蒙版和路徑蒙版）來隱藏或者顯示影片的各個部分
-可摳圖（鋼筆工具、套索工具、塗抹工具和文字工具等自定義形狀摳圖工具）
-快進、倒播視頻，給視頻添加慢動作鏡頭（1/12慢速至16倍速）
- 360度旋轉影片
-多種混合影像模式
-各種字體、文字模版、文字顏色、表情符號、陰影、文字描邊等
-內寘多種風格的免費配樂和音效，可添加電腦上的音樂或者iTunes裏的音樂，還可選取匯出視頻裏的音訊
-給視頻配音錄音
-直接在影片上用手指繪畫塗鴉
-專業視頻比例，可縮放的時間線，無限制的軌道圖層
-簡單自動跟蹤功能
-添加移動式馬賽克
-自定義影片背景顏色
-可調整素材亮度、對比度、飽和度
-創建自己的Gif動畫
-私人定制特效片頭（需另外購買）
-多達幾十種濾鏡特效（素描、漫畫、魚眼、放大鏡、顏色濾鏡等）
-多達幾十種場景切換特效
-可給視頻／照片設定各種外觀如圓形、心形和鑽石等，甚至自定義獨一無二的形狀
-可設定疊加視頻／照片的透明色（Chroma Key），比如去除照片中純色背景色（綠幕藍幕摳像）
-能把視頻／照片變黑白，把需要突出的部分還原色彩突出出來（Color Splash）
-能自由變形視頻／照片成不規則形狀
-給視頻／照片／文字添加運動點，使它們動起來，縮放、旋轉和移動結合起來可創建出各種各樣的絢麗效果
-實时預覽，高分辨視頻輸出
-可通過Wi-Fi直接從電腦導入多媒體素材：視頻、照片、音樂和Gif動畫等
-可直接保存並分享影片到社交網絡，如雲盤、微信、QQ、抖音等

回合制策略 + 牌組構築 Roguelite
各具特色的英雄、技能、遺物與敵人
封印系統——透過試煉與契約自訂難度
挑戰模式——每週變化的規則與排行榜競爭

隨機生成的地牢

一次冒險，遠遠不夠。

mo.description:
擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

■ 隨選擇擴展的技能樹
從攻擊力、攻擊速度、特殊能力等方向中，選擇自己想要的成長路線。
優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

■ 不斷變強的武器
武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

遊戲特色
- 越戰越強的增量式成長
- 透過收集資源與反覆強化提升火力
- 隨選擇變化的技能樹
- 運用卡牌和遺物搭配流派
- 個性十足的異次元傭兵
- 閃電、冰凍、隕石、迴旋鏢等多種能力
- 可持續強化的武器
- 可愛的2D像素畫面
- 鋪滿畫面的史萊姆與爽快打擊感

※ 注意：查看成長數值時，時間可能會轉眼消失！

mo.description:
Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

== Game Intro ==

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

◆Lighthearted Additional Content◆
Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

◆iCloud Support◆
Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

※The story in this game is the same as in previous releases.

Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? 
Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures! You have to experience every company’s struggles in this fantasy workspace simulation, from sick leaves to strikes, and manage your team to run the most impenetrable dungeon! 
In this "reverse-Darkest Dungeon", climb the corporate ladder and optimize your strategy to become the most fearsome (and, perhaps, respected) boss in dungeon history!

- Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business
- Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies
- Manage your resource budget: On top of morale, gold, blood, and tears must be spent wisely in this economy. 
- Being bad never looked this good: see your enemies perish in drop-dead gorgeous animations. Watch out for stains!

Unlock the three DLCS : Return Of The Goddess, Feed The Troll and Soul Smugglers. Buy them separately, or together with the DLC Bundle.

有史以來最好的劈砍遊戲現在能夠放進您的口袋裡了！

最初於2006年在電腦上發布的《泰坦之旅》是一款動作角色扮演遊戲，設定為神話的背景。泰坦從監獄逃脫，不顧一切地要毀滅地球。上帝自個不能阻止他們-需要一個英雄來領導這場史詩般的爭鬥。勝利或失敗都將決定人類的命運和奧林匹亞的命運。

這個特別適用於移動設備的新版本提供了許多新的特點：

● 全新的點觸操作界面

混合了遠古神話和不停的動作的《泰坦之旅》是一款典型的劈砍遊戲，以快速、激烈的節奏提供活力十足的遊戲。征服驚心動魄的挑戰，戰勝入侵移動世界的最強大敵人！

可在應用內購買的DLC： 
● 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。

● 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！
● 在永恆餘燼DLC 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

This Is the Police 2是廣受好評的黑色劇“This Is the Police”的續集，你可以在其中酌情解釋法律！運行警長的部門，管理你的員警，調查，審問和監禁。在這個由故事推動的冒險、戰略和回合制戰術戰鬥混合遊戲中，做出艱難的決定 - 並儘量避免自己入獄！

這是模擬？管理遊戲？戰術挑戰？視覺小說？謎題？全部都是，還不止！

深入獨一無二的故事推動體驗。
歡迎來到夏普伍德，一個寒冷而嚴酷的邊境小鎮，充滿了暴力，沒有人是完全無辜的。這個城鎮是走私者、幫派和尖叫的民粹主義者的老巢。為了維護和平與秩序，年輕的警長莉莉·裡德（莎拉·漢密爾頓）不得不與逃犯傑克·博伊德（喬恩·聖約翰）合作，並祈禱她的危險計畫不會失控。

掌管警長的部門。
你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

tw.description:
畫面中央，一位太空旅人坐在細細的線上。把視野打開，原來這條線連著兩顆星球。

Duopaper 為你的螢幕準備這樣的小小發現。同一張桌布，合起來時是一處細節，展開後是一個更完整的場景。原本熟悉的角落，因為多看見一點而變得有趣。讓寬螢幕的空間，不只裝下更多，也裝下更多想像。

找一張讓你停下來看的圖
有些畫乾淨安靜，有些帶著俏皮的角色，有些把宇宙與海洋變成一段奇遇。每幅作品經過挑選，保留鮮明構圖與自己的個性。從局部看到全貌，慢慢找出適合你心情的那一張。

選你喜歡的視覺語言
簡約、插圖、漫畫、立體、圖像設計與繪畫，各有不同的表情。可以依風格瀏覽，或搜尋作品名稱。喜歡柔和色調、鮮明對比，還是乾淨的留白？讓螢幕的樣子，跟著你的品味走。

先試著打開它

把喜歡的好好收著

全部內容免費使用，沒有廣告、App 內購買或訂閱，也不必建立帳號。少一點打擾，多一點看圖的樂趣。

tw.releaseNotes: Digline 的內容越來越多囉！有傳言說，從你鄰居家再往左走，來了一位神秘的新人物。他還帶來了一大堆實驗，等你在鑽機上試一試。至少有幾個應該會成功……大概吧。
tw.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

每次冒險，不同的策略。不同的英雄。不同的結局。

■ 獨具特色的英雄——不只是數值不同，玩法也截然不同。

刺客：對單一目標造成雙倍傷害。鎖定目標，一擊制勝。
工程師：累積護盾，釋放毀滅性的範圍攻擊。防禦就是進攻。
賭徒：升級時免費重抽選項。讓運氣也成為策略。
貴族：升級選項+1，還能在神殿花費金幣升級。金錢就是武器。

……每位英雄，都需要完全不同的策略。

■ 豐富的技能卡牌——重點不是收集，而是組合。你的牌組就是你的策略。

連鎖閃電：連續攻擊最多3名敵人
雙重施法：連續發動兩次相同技能
複製：立即複製牌組中的任意卡牌

技能品質：普通 → 稀有 → 史詩 → 傳說
在戰鬥中強化卡牌，創造強大的技能組合。

■ 強大的遺物——有時，一件遺物就能改變一切。

聖杯：死亡時以50%生命值復活一次
崩塌碎片：接下來3場戰鬥中，所有非首領敵人以1點生命值登場
束縛枷鎖：每回合魔力+1，但商店價格上漲25%
聖域提燈：每次進入商店時完全恢復生命值

■ 各具特色的敵人——每場戰鬥都是全新的謎題。看不透敵人的行動，就無法生存。

寶藏哥布林：若未在7回合內擊敗，便會逃跑
雪人：凍結玩家1回合
烏鴉：強制隨機棄掉一張手牌

還有擁有獨特攻擊模式與多個戰鬥階段的強大首領。

■ 封印系統——真正的挑戰從這裡開始。

普通模式僅僅是開始。
隨著封印逐漸解鎖，更加殘酷的挑戰接踵而至。

自由組合試煉與契約，打造專屬於你的遊戲難度。
只有極少數玩家能夠征服最困難的組合。

■ 挑戰模式——每週新規則，每週新競爭。

每週輪替的大契約與試煉。
在熟悉的策略不再奏效的環境中，尋找最強牌組搭配。

與其他玩家爭奪最高分，挑戰每週排行榜。
突破挑戰的最終區域，即可進入無盡戰場。

面對不斷變強的敵人，你究竟能撐多久？

■ 無限重玩樂趣

3個區域 × 11層——每次冒險都會隨機生成的地牢
戰鬥、事件、精英、神殿、商店等豐富的房間類型
每次都有不同的地圖、敵人組合與卡牌獎勵

即使選擇相同的英雄，也不會有完全相同的冒險。

■ 遊戲特色

回合制策略 + 牌組構築 Roguelite
各具特色的英雄、技能、遺物與敵人
封印系統——透過試煉與契約自訂難度
挑戰模式——每週變化的規則與排行榜競爭
無盡戰場——挑戰極限的無盡戰鬥
隨機生成的地牢
支援多種語言
雲端存檔

用屬於你的策略，徹底征服地牢。
一次冒險，遠遠不夠。

擊敗史萊姆，收集資源，變得更加強大！

這是一款隨著戰鬥不斷進行，攻擊力與火力會無限提升的增量式動作遊戲。擴展技能樹，組合卡牌與遺物，將鋪滿畫面的史萊姆大軍一舉掃蕩！

■ 越戰越強，看得見的成長
擊敗史萊姆以獲取資源和戰利品，並強化角色與武器。
隨著實力不斷累積，起初難以對付的敵人也能在瞬間消滅。體驗增量遊戲的樂趣：變得更強、狩獵更快、獲得更多獎勵。

■ 隨選擇擴展的技能樹
從攻擊力、攻擊速度、特殊能力等方向中，選擇自己想要的成長路線。
優先強化哪些技能，將會改變戰鬥方式與成長速度。按照自己的策略建構技能樹，完成強大的流派。

■ 卡牌與遺物帶來的爆炸火力
組合戰鬥中獲得的卡牌和遺物，即可解鎖新的能力與成長效果。
召喚閃電、釋放會在牆壁之間反彈的迴旋鏢，並使用強力特殊武器掌控戰場。隨著流派逐漸成形，戰鬥也會變得更加華麗、更為強大。

■ 助力成長與戰鬥的傭兵
跨越次元而來的個性傭兵，會以各自獨特的方式追蹤並攻擊敵人。
凍結敵人、召喚隕石，並使用能夠攻擊大範圍區域的傭兵技能。培養並組合傭兵，打造更加高效的戰鬥策略。

■ 不斷變強的武器
武器強化得越多，攻擊範圍和火力就會變得越強。
突破成長極限，以壓倒性的攻擊掃蕩蜂擁而來的史萊姆。不斷累積的成長，將化為爆發力十足的爽快打擊感。

■ 簡單操作，深度成長
體驗任何人都能輕鬆上手的直覺操作，以及豐富多樣的成長系統。
戰鬥方式雖然簡單，但透過組合技能樹、卡牌、遺物、傭兵和武器，可以打造出截然不同的成長策略。

■ 《史萊姆大騷動》的秘密
原本寧靜的米阿勒特峽谷，被一支來歷不明的史萊姆軍團占領了。
獵殺不斷湧來的史萊姆，突破極限並持續成長。你能否找出引發這場巨大騷動的真正幕後黑手，讓峽谷重歸和平？

遊戲特色
- 越戰越強的增量式成長
- 透過收集資源與反覆強化提升火力
- 隨選擇變化的技能樹
- 運用卡牌和遺物搭配流派
- 個性十足的異次元傭兵
- 閃電、冰凍、隕石、迴旋鏢等多種能力
- 可持續強化的武器
- 可愛的2D像素畫面
- 鋪滿畫面的史萊姆與爽快打擊感

tw.description:
Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

有史以來最好的劈砍遊戲現在能夠放進您的口袋裡了！

最初於2006年在電腦上發布的《泰坦之旅》是一款動作角色扮演遊戲，設定為神話的背景。泰坦從監獄逃脫，不顧一切地要毀滅地球。上帝自個不能阻止他們-需要一個英雄來領導這場史詩般的爭鬥。勝利或失敗都將決定人類的命運和奧林匹亞的命運。

您就是英雄！創建您的角色，探索遠古的文明如希臘、埃及、巴比倫和中國，並與成群的傳奇生物戰鬥！掌握射箭、劍法或者魔法的藝術，併升級您的角色來解鎖令人驚嘆的力量！發現特別的項目來幫助您完成您的任務：傳說中的劍，毀滅性的雷電，施了魔法的弓，以及更多！

這個特別適用於移動設備的新版本提供了許多新的特點：

● 全新的點觸操作界面
● 完全重新設計的點觸遊戲
● 高品質的圖形
● 巨大的、開放的世界供您探索
● 完全的日/夜循環
● 80種不同的神話生物：牛頭人身怪，獨眼巨人，蛇發女妖和更多

● 30個不同的角色分類
● 150種不同的角色技能
● 超過60個小時的巨量遊戲時間
● 逐級增進的難度模式：與您的技能水平匹配的武器和敵人
● 數十種不可鎖定的成就等待您去發現
● 無廣告，沒有微交易。

混合了遠古神話和不停的動作的《泰坦之旅》是一款典型的劈砍遊戲，以快速、激烈的節奏提供活力十足的遊戲。征服驚心動魄的挑戰，戰勝入侵移動世界的最強大敵人！

可在應用內購買的DLC： 
● 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。
● 在諸神黃昏下載包的北歐未知土地上，你將勇敢面對凱爾特人、諾斯曼人和阿斯加迪神靈的領地！
● 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！
● 在永恆餘燼DLC 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

This Is the Police 2是廣受好評的黑色劇“This Is the Police”的續集，你可以在其中酌情解釋法律！運行警長的部門，管理你的員警，調查，審問和監禁。在這個由故事推動的冒險、戰略和回合制戰術戰鬥混合遊戲中，做出艱難的決定 - 並儘量避免自己入獄！

這是模擬？管理遊戲？戰術挑戰？視覺小說？謎題？全部都是，還不止！

深入獨一無二的故事推動體驗。
歡迎來到夏普伍德，一個寒冷而嚴酷的邊境小鎮，充滿了暴力，沒有人是完全無辜的。這個城鎮是走私者、幫派和尖叫的民粹主義者的老巢。為了維護和平與秩序，年輕的警長莉莉·裡德（莎拉·漢密爾頓）不得不與逃犯傑克·博伊德（喬恩·聖約翰）合作，並祈禱她的危險計畫不會失控。

掌管警長的部門。
你的下屬不僅僅是一些資源，他們是有各自長處、弱點、恐懼和偏見的活人 - 為了存活，你必須應對所有這些人。你的人喝得太多了嗎？或者總是有不上班的藉口？還是他拒絕遵守命令？如果想在這個部門維持紀律，你必須施展堅定的手腕。

參與戰術戰鬥。
在最危險的操作中，遊戲將切換到回合制戰鬥。召集你最好的員警團隊。仔細研究地形，調整計畫，悄悄接近嫌疑人並使用非致命武器和裝備 - 如果情況允許的話。沒錯，有時槍戰幾乎是不可避免的，但要小心：“This Is the Police 2”遊戲沒有生命值。一顆子彈就可能讓員警喪命。

成為一名真正的偵探。
收集證據，研究案件材料，審問嫌犯並將罪犯送上法庭。如果嫌疑人是無辜的？也許是時候看看是否可以收買夏普伍德的法官。

us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

us.description:
Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs
- Weapons that can be continuously upgraded

- Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact

us.description:
Did you know that “Schadenfreude” is a German word defined as the concept of finding joy in someone else’s misfortune? It is also the main idea on which Neighbours back From Hell is built. A whole TV show based on playing increasingly outrageous pranks on your grumpy neighbor to keep the audience entertained and viewership numbers high. It’s good to be bad in this early 2000s trash TV-inspired slapstick extravaganza!

As Woody, the vengeful star protagonist, you will prank your way through Seasons 1 and 2 of this fictitious, but aptly named TV show. Take the mischief from your nasty neighbor’s flat all the way to China, India, and Mexico where you will make sure his holiday is a living hell. While you’re at it, why limit your antics to your neighbor when you can involve his mother and fellow travelers?

Whatever you decide to do, your trusty camera crew will be right there to catch all the action! Let your crooked creativity flow freely and watch the neighbor rage in desperation. Just be mindful not to get caught by him or his companions, or they will whoop you good and your TV show will be taken off the air! If you perform well by creating chaos in the neighbor’s life, ratings will increase, and you could win prestigious awards!

Neighbours From Hell 1 & 2 Remastered in one package: 28 episodes set in the neighbor’s home, on a cruise liner, and in several different holiday locations around the world!

- All graphics newly rendered in Full HD
- Framerate of all animations doubled for a smoother experience
- Use stealth, skill, and style to perform the perfect ambush

- Superb cartoon-style graphics

Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more!

Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience.
Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control.

Take charge of the Sheriff’s department.
Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department.

Engage in tactical combat.
During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life.

Become a true detective.
Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought.

Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’!

us.description:
Golden hour happens every single day. Most people miss it. SolarArc makes sure you don't.

- Chasing golden hour for a photo? Know the exact minute it starts.
- Planning a sunrise hike? See the best trail windows at a glance.
- Wondering when the moon rises tonight? It's right there on your screen.

SolarArc is a sun and moon tracker that feels like looking out the window. Every view shifts with the real sky - warm when the light is warm, dark when the sky is dark.

THE GRADIENT LINE

Your entire day, painted in one line. Dawn amber bleeds into midday blue, then sunset orange, then deep navy night. Golden hour glows. Blue hour cools. You can read the exact times, or just glance at the color and know where you are in the day.

THE ARC

The sun and moon traced across your sky in real time. Watch them rise, climb, and fall against a live gradient that shifts with the actual light outside your window. Drag your finger across the arc to scrub through the day - the sky, the times, and the numbers all move with you. View the sun alone, the moon alone, or both together.

THE MOON

Know when to look up. SolarArc renders tonight's moon with the correct phase shape on the arc. Plan around full moons. Catch a crescent at dusk. Know exactly how dark the sky will be.

52-WEEK FORECAST

What will golden hour look like three Saturdays from now? How much daylight will you have on that hiking trip in April? Pick any date in the next year and see the full picture - sun, moon, and light - before you commit.

FIVE WAYS TO USE THE SKY

Photography - Golden hour and blue hour, down to the minute. Stop guessing when to shoot.
Hiking - Best trail windows and how much daylight is left. Know when to turn around.
Screens - A screen curfew that follows the sun. Wind down as the sky does.
Gardening - When to water, when to protect, and how many sun hours your plants get today.
Stargazing - When true darkness begins. The best window to see everything above you.

FEATURES

- Live gradient line and arc visualizations
- Drag to scrub through any moment of the day
- Sun view, moon view, or dual view
- Golden hour and blue hour timing
- Moonrise, moonset, phase, and illumination
- 52-week forecast for any date
- Five activity modes
- Seven Home Screen widgets: sun and moon, line and arc, medium and large
- Notifications for sunrise, sunset, and golden hour
- Multi-location with automatic timezone handling
- Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Ukrainian, and Russian
- Built on NOAA solar and Meeus lunar algorithms
- Fully offline. No tracking. No account required.

WHAT IS GOLDEN HOUR?

Golden hour is the short window after sunrise and before sunset when the light turns soft, warm, and directional. Photographers chase it. Hikers love it. SolarArc tells you exactly when it happens, wherever you are.

EVERYTHING INCLUDED

All seven widgets, the 52-week forecast, unlimited saved places, all five modes, and golden hour, sunrise, and sunset alerts.

One purchase. No subscription. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Made by Spruzzo Labs - a creative lab.

Questions or ideas? hello@spruzzolabs.com

tr.description:
Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes.

Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure.

Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive.

◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero

Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you.

At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes.

Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress.

◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations

Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more.

Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies.

Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive.

◆ Transform into Skel and Fight

Traps are not your only weapon.

Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself.

Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line.

When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself.

◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings

Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves.

How long can your dungeon survive?

Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world.

◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time

Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage.

Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score.

Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters.

◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run

Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger.

Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics.

There is always one more strategy to discover.

◆ Full Controller Support

Prefer playing with a controller?

Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad.

On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls.

◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability

Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave.

• Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression
• 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies
• Multiple Skel forms for direct combat
• 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode
• Global ranking competition
• More than 30 perks that change every run
• Permanent upgrades, relics, and hidden synergies
• Full gamepad support
• Cloud save support
• Playable in 13 languages

If you enjoy tower defense games, roguelikes and roguelites, dungeon management, base defense, strategy games, or survivor-style action, Skel & Defense was built for you.

The heroes are already coming.

Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

tr.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimise routes to maximise each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

tr.description:
Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs
- Weapons that can be continuously upgraded
- Cute 2D pixel art
- Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...

One of the best hack-and-slash games of all time now fits in your pocket!

Originally released on PC in 2006, Titan Quest is an action RPG set against a mythological backdrop. The Titans have escaped from prison and are hell-bent on destroying the Earth. The Gods alone can’t stop them -- a hero is needed to lead this epic struggle. Victory or defeat will determine humanity’s fate and that of the Olympians.

You are that hero! Create your character, explore ancient civilizations like Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China, and fight against hordes of legendary creatures! Master the arts of archery, swordsmanship or magic and upgrade your character to unlock awesome powers! Discover special items to help you complete your quest: legendary swords, devastating thunderbolts, enchanted bows, and much more!

● A huge, open world to explore

Did you know that “Schadenfreude” is a German word defined as the concept of finding joy in someone else’s misfortune? It is also the main idea on which Neighbours back From Hell is built. A whole TV show based on playing increasingly outrageous pranks on your grumpy neighbour to keep the audience entertained and viewership numbers high. It’s good to be bad in this early 2000s trash TV-inspired slapstick extravaganza!

As Woody, the vengeful star protagonist, you will prank your way through Seasons 1 and 2 of this fictitious, but aptly named TV show. Take the mischief from your nasty neighbour’s flat all the way to China, India, and Mexico where you will make sure his holiday is a living hell. While you’re at it, why limit your antics to your neighbour when you can involve his mother and fellow travellers?

Whatever you decide to do, your trusty camera crew will be right there to catch all the action! Let your crooked creativity flow freely and watch the neighbour rage in desperation. Just be mindful not to get caught by him or his companions, or they will whoop you good and your TV show will be taken off the air! Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat.

Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more!

Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience.
Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control.

Take charge of the Sheriff’s department.
Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department.

Engage in tactical combat.
During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life.

Become a true detective.
Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought.

Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’!

tr.description:
Golden hour happens every single day. Most people miss it. SolarArc makes sure you don't.

- Chasing golden hour for a photo? Know the exact minute it starts.
- Planning a sunrise hike? See the best trail windows at a glance.
- Wondering when the moon rises tonight? It's right there on your screen.

SolarArc is a sun and moon tracker that feels like looking out the window. Every view shifts with the real sky - warm when the light is warm, dark when the sky is dark.

THE GRADIENT LINE

Your entire day, painted in one line. Dawn amber bleeds into midday blue, then sunset orange, then deep navy night. Golden hour glows. Blue hour cools. You can read the exact times, or just glance at the color and know where you are in the day.

THE ARC

The sun and moon traced across your sky in real time. Watch them rise, climb, and fall against a live gradient that shifts with the actual light outside your window. Drag your finger across the arc to scrub through the day - the sky, the times, and the numbers all move with you. View the sun alone, the moon alone, or both together.

THE MOON

Know when to look up. SolarArc renders tonight's moon with the correct phase shape on the arc. Plan around full moons. Catch a crescent at dusk. Know exactly how dark the sky will be.

52-WEEK FORECAST

What will golden hour look like three Saturdays from now? How much daylight will you have on that hiking trip in April? Pick any date in the next year and see the full picture - sun, moon, and light - before you commit.

FIVE WAYS TO USE THE SKY

Photography - Golden hour and blue hour, down to the minute. Stop guessing when to shoot.
Hiking - Best trail windows and how much daylight is left. Know when to turn around.
Screens - A screen curfew that follows the sun. Wind down as the sky does.
Gardening - When to water, when to protect, and how many sun hours your plants get today.
Stargazing - When true darkness begins. The best window to see everything above you.

FEATURES

- Live gradient line and arc visualizations
- Drag to scrub through any moment of the day
- Sun view, moon view, or dual view
- Golden hour and blue hour timing
- Moonrise, moonset, phase, and illumination
- 52-week forecast for any date
- Five activity modes
- Seven Home Screen widgets: sun and moon, line and arc, medium and large
- Notifications for sunrise, sunset, and golden hour
- Multi-location with automatic timezone handling
- Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Ukrainian, and Russian
- Built on NOAA solar and Meeus lunar algorithms
- Fully offline. No tracking. No account required.

WHAT IS GOLDEN HOUR?

Golden hour is the short window after sunrise and before sunset when the light turns soft, warm, and directional. Photographers chase it. Hikers love it. SolarArc tells you exactly when it happens, wherever you are.

EVERYTHING INCLUDED

All seven widgets, the 52-week forecast, unlimited saved places, all five modes, and golden hour, sunrise, and sunset alerts.

One purchase. No subscription. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Made by Spruzzo Labs - a creative lab.

pt.description:
Construa a masmorra. Prepare as armadilhas. Espere pelos heróis.

Skel & Defense é um roguelike de defesa de masmorra em que você assume o papel do vilão. Expanda sua masmorra sala por sala, encha-a de armadilhas mortais, transforme-se em Skel e impeça onda após onda de heróis de roubar seu tesouro.

Combine a estratégia de tower defense com a rejogabilidade de um roguelike e construa uma masmorra que nenhum grupo de aventureiros consiga atravessar.

◆ Torne-se o mestre da masmorra

Toda masmorra tem um monstro esperando na escuridão. Desta vez, esse monstro é você.

Durante a noite, expanda a masmorra e prepare suas armadilhas. Durante o dia, defenda os portões das ondas de invasores.

Construa, defenda, melhore e repita. Transforme uma simples cripta subterrânea em uma fortaleza impenetrável.

◆ 26 salas de armadilhas e inúmeras combinações

Combine 26 tipos de salas com bolas de fogo, lava, névoa congelante, estalactites de gelo, serras, flechas envenenadas, campos eletromagnéticos e muito mais.

Reúna salas do mesmo elemento para desbloquear sinergias poderosas.

Congele os inimigos antes de queimá-los. Prenda-os em corredores estreitos e termine o trabalho com veneno. Você decide o layout; sobreviver é problema dos heróis.

◆ Transforme-se em Skel e lute

Armadilhas não são sua única arma.

Transforme-se em diferentes Skels e enfrente os invasores diretamente.

Lance bolas de fogo da retaguarda como Mage Skel, arremesse shurikens como Rogue Skel ou segure a linha de frente como Shield Skel.

Se as armadilhas não forem suficientes, termine o trabalho pessoalmente.

◆ 7 fases, modo infinito e ranking global

Supere 7 fases com diferentes recompensas e depois encare o modo infinito, com ondas cada vez mais difíceis.

Até onde sua masmorra consegue resistir?

Registre um apelido para participar do ranking global e competir com jogadores do mundo inteiro.

◆ Mais de 30 perks, uma partida diferente a cada vez

Escolha entre mais de 30 perks durante cada fase.

Pegue melhorias poderosas ou aceite penalidades perigosas em troca de pontos bônus.

Aposte tudo nas armadilhas, fortaleça seu Skel ou combine as duas estratégias. Cada run é diferente e cada escolha importa.

◆ Fique mais forte a cada run

Derrote ondas para ganhar pontos de características e desbloquear melhorias permanentes para as próximas partidas.

Explore a coleção para encontrar sinergias escondidas, novas salas e relíquias poderosas.

Sempre há mais uma estratégia para descobrir.

◆ Suporte completo a controle

Construa salas, escolha perks, use a loja, teletransporte-se e consulte a coleção usando um gamepad.

Os comandos aparecem na tela e você pode alternar entre controle e toque quando quiser.

◆ Dungeon defense premium feito para jogar várias vezes

Partidas curtas, estratégia profunda e aquela vontade de sobreviver a só mais uma onda.

• Dungeon defense com progressão roguelike
• 26 salas de armadilhas com sinergias elementais
• Diferentes formas de Skel para combate direto
• 7 fases e modo infinito
• Ranking global
• Mais de 30 perks
• Melhorias permanentes, relíquias e sinergias escondidas
• Suporte completo a gamepad
• Salvamento na nuvem
• Disponível em 13 idiomas

Se você gosta de tower defense, roguelike, roguelite, gerenciamento de masmorras, defesa de base, estratégia ou ação estilo survivor, Skel & Defense foi feito para você.

Os heróis já estão chegando.

Construa sua masmorra, prepare suas armadilhas e mostre quem é o verdadeiro mestre.

pt.description:
Vocês já está cansado das mesas velhas histórias? Você está interessado em jogos narrativos, romances gráficos, jogos baseados em chat e jogos indie, mas você está cansado da mesma coisa? Se sim, você deveria checar '7Days', um jogo de mistério com romance gráfico e baseado em decisões. 

'7Days' é um jogo narrativo de mistério com romance gráfico. É um jogo narrativo único baseado em decisões onde o usuário pode criar suas histórias baseadas na escolha que ele fizer.

Nós fornecemos a melhor experiência de um jogo narrativo com um enredo de mistério em estilo bate papo, projetado para dispositivos móveis. É um jogo altamente recomendado para você.

■ Jogo explicado
Toda escolha muda a sua história.
Cada pequena escolha irá mudar seu relacionamento com seus companheiros,
e altera seu destino e de seus companheiros nos momentos críticos.

Você pode ser o vilão ou um companheiro de confiança.
Tudo depende de suas escolhas.

■ Resumo
Existem espíritos que foram colocados ao testa para ressurreição no mundo da morte.
O mensageiro da morte os atribuiu com a tarefa de se atacarem ou trabalharem juntos. Seu personagem, Kirell, deve completar tambés as tarefas baseadas em escolhas que lhe foram atribuídas.
Mas suas tarefas necessitam que outros morram...

Você só tem 7 dias
O que você irá escolher?

Experimente está história que provoca a imaginação agora mesmo.

■ Características do jogo
- Estilo quadrinho com gráficos incríveis
- Enredo único que alterna entre a vida e a morte
- O enredo muda de acordo com suas escolhas
- Várias conquistas e desafios ocultos
- Episódios e finais diferentes baseados na história
- Aventura de texto com uma sensação misteriosa
- Enredo excitante

■ Recomendado para aqueles que:
- Estão interessados em conteúdo/texto interativo como romances gráficos, jogos narrativos, jogos de bate papo e jogos sociais
- São apaixonados por jogos indie como 'Undertale'
- Estão procurando por uma jogo narrativo com elementos de mistério e/ou terror
- Estão procurando por O jogo e estão cansados dos jogos narrativos de sempre
- Estão interessados em diferentes tipos de jogos de aventura
Nós também recomendamos 'Underworld Office: Ghost Game', outro de nossos grandes jogos.

■ Nós garantimos a diversão. Baixe e experimente agora

Se você encontrar algum problema ou tem alguma sugestão, por favor, envie para nós em help@buffstudio.com. Nós trabalhamos duro para fazer os melhores jogos de aventura, narrativos, indie, restauradores e romances gráficos.

■ Nós precisamos da sua ajuda para fazer jogos narrativos melhores. Por favor, recomende este jogo narrativo para sua família e amigos. Será de grande ajuda para nós.

pt.description:
Feche para ver um pormenor. Abra para descobrir o resto da história.

O Duopaper reúne uma seleção cuidada de arte digital para explorar com dois enquadramentos. A vista fechada concentra o olhar; a vista aberta revela toda a composição. Uma só imagem cria a surpresa, tanto num ecrã dobrável como num formato mais amplo.

Descubra seis estilos: minimalista, ilustração, banda desenhada, tridimensional, gráfico e pintura. De ambientes serenos a composições cheias de personalidade, encontre imagens em alta definição que façam sentido no seu ecrã.

Desloque o controlo de abertura para comparar as duas vistas. Experimente o relógio, ajuste o ponto de enquadramento e leia a história da imagem. Utilize a pesquisa e guarde as suas escolhas nos favoritos para as reencontrar, mesmo sem ligação à internet.

Toda a coleção está disponível sem anúncios, compras integradas nem conta. Guarde o JPEG inteiro em Fotografias ou partilhe-o através do menu do sistema. O relógio e os ajustes de enquadramento afetam apenas a pré-visualização; a composição exportada mantém-se completa.

Depois de guardar, defina manualmente o fundo em Fotografias; a pré-visualização é uma referência e o recorte ou a animação do sistema podem ser diferentes.

pt.releaseNotes: Cada vez mais conteúdo para o Digline! Diz-se que, para lá da casa do teu vizinho, à esquerda, chegou uma nova personagem misteriosa. E traz montes de experiências para testares na tua broca. Pelo menos algumas devem funcionar... talvez.
pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

pt.description:
Add virtual shifting to any indoor training app.

BikeControl (formerly SwiftControl) turns a controller you already own into a virtual shifter: Shimano Di2, SRAM AXS / eTap, WHEELTOP EDS, Zwift Click, Zwift Play, Zwift Ride, CYCPLUS BC2, Thinkrider VS200, a Bluetooth remote or a gamepad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
▶ Virtual gear shifting - in apps that support it natively, and in apps that do not
▶ Steering and turning
▶ Adjust workout intensity
▶ Control music on your device
▶ Tune everything around shifting: gear count, ratios, gearing
▶ More? If you can do it by keyboard, mouse or touch, you can do it with BikeControl

WORKS WITH
Officially supported, built in natively: MyWhoosh, Rouvy, TrainingPeaks Virtual, Strappo
Also supported: Zwift, Biketerra, FulGaz and any other app you can drive by keyboard or touch

BikeControl applies the gear change at the trainer and sends the resulting resistance to the app, so virtual shifting works even in apps that have no virtual shifting of their own.

SHIMANO Di2 AND SRAM AXS
Pair the road shifters you already ride outdoors and use them to shift virtual gears indoors. No extra hardware, no adapters.

SUPPORTED CONTROLLERS
▶ Zwift Click, Click v2, Ride and Play
▶ Shimano Di2
▶ SRAM AXS and eTap, every individual button
▶ WHEELTOP EDS
▶ Wahoo Kickr Bike Shift, Pro, V1 and V2
▶ CYCPLUS BC2 and Thinkrider VS200 virtual shifters
▶ Elite Sterzo Smart and Elite Square Smart Frame, for steering
▶ Gamepads, Bluetooth HID devices and keyboards
▶ Your phone on the handlebar, steering with its sensors

OPEN SOURCE
BikeControl is open source: https://github.com/OpenBikeControl/bikecontrol

PRIVACY
▶ BikeControl only accesses your screen to perform the gestures you configure
▶ All gesture configurations stay on your device
▶ No personal data is collected or transmitted

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zwift, Inc., Shimano, SRAM, Wahoo or Elite.

pt.description:
Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge!
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play.

Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

…Every hero demands a different strategy.

■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot

Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary
Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations.

■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything.

Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.

Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases.

■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here.

Normal mode is only the beginning.
As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await.

Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations.

■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week.

Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week.
Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work.

Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings.
Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle.

How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger?

■ Endless Replayability

3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time

Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike.

■ Features

Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite
Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings
Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies
Procedurally generated dungeons
Multiple languages supported
Cloud save

Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.

pt.description:
Defeat slimes, gather resources, and grow even stronger!

This is an incremental action game where your attack power and firepower increase endlessly with every battle. Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep!

■ Visible Progress with Every Fight
Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons.
Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards.

■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices
Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities.
The skills you upgrade first will change both your combat style and progression speed. Build your skill tree around your own strategy and complete a powerful build.

■ Explosive Firepower with Cards and Relics
Combine cards and relics obtained in battle to unlock new abilities and progression bonuses.
Call down lightning, summon boomerangs that ricochet off walls, and dominate the battlefield with powerful special weapons. As your build comes together, battles become even flashier and more powerful.

■ Mercenaries That Support Your Progress and Combat
Unique mercenaries from across dimensions track and attack enemies in their own ways.
Freeze enemies, call down meteors, and use wide-area mercenary skills. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies.

■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger
Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower.
Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits.

■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression
Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems.
Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies.

■ The Secret of No More Slimes!!
The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army.
Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge?

Game Features
- Incremental progression that makes you stronger with every battle
- Increased firepower through resource gathering and repeated upgrades
- A skill tree that changes based on your choices
- Build combinations using cards and relics
- Unique interdimensional mercenaries
- A wide variety of abilities, including lightning, freezing, meteors, and boomerangs
- Weapons that can be continuously upgraded
- Cute 2D pixel art
- Screen-filling slime hordes and satisfying combat impact

※ Warning: You may lose track of time while watching your stats go up!

Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

pt.description:
Um dos melhores jogos de corta e massacra (hack-and-slash) agora no seu celular!

Originalmente lançado para PC em 2006, Titan Quest é um RPG de ação em um cenário mitológico. Os Titãs escaparam da prisão e estão determinados em destruir a Terra. Os Deuses não conseguem impedi-los e será necessário um herói para liderar essa luta épica. A vitória ou a derrota determinarão o destino da humanidade e dos olimpianos.

Você é esse herói! Crie o seu personagem, explore civilizações antigas como Grécia, Egito, Babilônia e China, e lute contra hordas de criaturas lendárias! Domine as artes de arco e flecha, esgrima ou magia e melhore seu personagem para destravar poderes incríveis! Descubra itens especiais para ajudá-lo a completar a sua missão: espadas lendárias, raios devastadores, arcos encantados e muito mais!

Especialmente adaptado para dispositivos móveis, esta versão oferece novos recursos:
● Jogue sem anúncios!
● Uma nova interface sensível ao toque
● Jogabilidade sensível ao toque completamente redesenhada
● Gráficos de alta qualidade
● Um mundo enorme e disponível para explorar
● Ciclo dia/noite completo
● 80 criaturas mitológicas diferentes: Minotauros, Ciclopes, Górgonas e muito mais
● 1200+ itens para descobrir
● 30 classes de personagem diferentes
● 150 habilidades de personagem diferentes 
● Hora da diversão colossal com mais de 60 horas 
● Modos de dificuldade escalável: as armas e os inimigos correspondem ao seu nível de habilidade 
● Dezenas de conquistas desbloqueáveis para descobrir 
● Sem anúncios, sem microtransações.

Misturando mitologia antiga com ação ininterrúpta, o Titan Quest é um clássico jogo de corta e massacra que oferece um ritmo rápido e intenso. Supere os desafios emocionantes e derrote os maiores inimigos de todos os tempos que estão tentando invadir o mundo dos dispositivos móveis!

DLCs disponíveis como compra in-app: 
● IMMORTAL THRONE - No DLC do Trono Imortal, você encontrará os maiores vilões da mitologia grega, enfrentará os ataques de Cerberus e se arriscará nas margens do Rio Styx. Você deve interpretar as profecias do vidente cego Tirésias, lutar ao lado de Agamenon e do Aquiles, além de usar os ardis de Odisseu para conquistar esta nova aventura sombria.
● RAGNARÖK - Nas terras desconhecidas do norte da Europa no Ragnarök DLC, você enfrentará os reinos dos celtas, dos homens do norte e dos deuses Asgardianos!
